lines.before: A standing grant (A27, the owner) lets a named outward act run without a yes per act. **Two acts are granted today: auto-fix's push (rule:outward-acts) and merge, through the merge gate** (`~/.claude/kit-tools/merge-gate.mjs`, outside every repo). **The grant:** six allow rules in the owner's own Claude settings for `merge-gate.mjs arm *`, `disarm *` and `autofix *`, in each shell's spelling (Bash `~/.claude/...`, PowerShell the full path in forward slashes); another spelling never matches, a wildcard path allows too much. Install prints the exact lines and each step, done or to do; Claude never writes them. Without them, each asks. **Consent:** row A27 lists merge, on main (track `standards/project-adapter.md`, `git add -f`, the owner merges its PR). **Before arming,** every check the gate lists must pass (`check <n>` runs them without arming). **GO:** it arms GitHub's auto-merge on the checked head and logs it; GitHub merges on green and deletes the branch. **NO GO:** nothing is armed; `<git dir>/kit-merge-gate-triage.md` says what failed; the thread fixes its part and reruns the gate; the rest is the owner's. **After arming:** a push first disarms it (the pre-push hook refuses one over an armed head), then the gate runs again; a stop set on GitHub is the owner's. A live turn tells the owner of the merge with its URL; nothing tells them of a later merge until E13 ships. **Kill switch:** `autonomy-off` in the Claude config folder: while it exists every merge and auto-fix push asks; an armed PR needs `disarm <n>`. **Never granted:** any other push, tag, release, branch deletes outside the merge, public posts, changing the grant or the gate, or anything a test or the sweep did not pass; each asks (rule:outward-acts). Why: the owner sets the conditions once and hears after with proof, and a gate the session can edit is no gate.
